svg.text: The archive is read by an explicit act. Nothing archived
shows up in the working view.
An archived item is readable and frozen. Changing one
means bringing it back first, and an archived goal still
A member deleted out of the archive, or a surrounding
that is now gone, leaves the bundle unreassemblable.
The whole bundle comes back as it went. No part of it
can be picked and nothing is re-parented, relocated or
One request serves all four archivable kinds: ideas,
goals, projects and tasks. Archived material is retained
on disk and reachable only this way.
A project brings its activities and their tasks; a goal
brings its measures and their check-in history. The
bundle is judged whole: a subset is never offered.
Ordering is relative, so the position an archived item
comes back to was never occupied while it was away.
